source: ISO 4032 style 1 hex nut M5 (coarse thread): width across flats s = 8.0 mm, thickness m = 4.7 mm (max values), across corners e min = 8.79 mm. Trap clearance and pocket depth are print conventions, assumed (see params).
frame: fastener: axis along Z, origin on the nut's bearing face (against its pocket floor), body toward +Z

across_corners.source: ISO 4032 e (min); the geometry cylinder is the circumscribed envelope of the hexagon

trap_clearance.source: ASSUMPTION: FDM slip clearance per flat side added to across_flats for a printed nut trap (uncertainty +/-0.1 mm; calibrate per printer)

pocket_depth.source: ASSUMPTION: thickness + 0.2 mm so the nut sits just below the pocket rim (uncertainty +/-0.2 mm)

bolt_clearance_diameter.source: ISO 273 medium-series through hole for the mating bolt

insertion_height.source: ASSUMPTION: a side-entry slot or open top must clear the nut thickness plus 1.0 mm (uncertainty +/-0.5 mm)

import_gate_notes: R1: bounding box = across_corners x across_corners x thickness, tolerance 0.2 mm (cylinder envelope of the hexagon: no hex primitive exists; its true plan size is across_flats x across_corners). Datum directions are unit vectors. Designed contact (nut on its pocket floor, bolt through its thread) is not interference; the pocket keepout is the printed trap volume, not a solid.
